title: The 2-Adic Magic Obstruction, Quaternary Bent-Hyperplane Rupture, Super-MUB Torsion Anomalies, and Divided-Power Characteristic-3 Alltop Constructions Across Product Weyl-Heisenberg Groups
description: Zero-Mathlib Lean 4.35.0 formalization (38 audited declarations strictly within [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound], verified across 6 independent proof kernels inside bubblewrap plus a live tamper-injecting negative gate) and 8-engine polyglot verifier (Rust, Zig, ISO C11 + x86-64 NASM, C++20, Python exact oracle + 9/9 isolated source-code mutation kills, QGTL, and Moonlab WASM, plus a source-level Eshkol AD companion specification) governing extremal Stabilizer Renyi Entropy across product Weyl-Heisenberg groups. Establishes: (I) universal 2-adic odd-qubit WH-MUB obstruction for all odd n >= 3 (T1a-T1d, sharp at n = 1, 2); (II) symplectic Lagrangian rigidity, Fermat Gaussian-square phase locking, universal Rothaus (1976) bent-function degree bound for all m >= 2, exhaustive F_2^4 bent classification (896 quadratics), and complete n = 4 Z_4 bent-hyperplane rupture closed inside Lean for arbitrary IsBent 2 f (T2a-T2e); (III) exact Z[zeta_8] WH-MUB fiducials and exact Z[i] Super-MUB witnesses in W(4) x W(2) and W(4) x W(4) strictly beating WH-MUB at alpha = 2, 3 while crossing above WH-MUB at alpha = 4, plus the four-tier order-16 hierarchy (T3a-T3e); (IV) universal two-stabilizer Parseval tower unifying n = 1, 2, 3, exact n = 4 stationary cubic, exact n = 5 SOS floor >= 3 ruptured by a Z[i]^32 witness, and universal k-uniform/AME Cauchy-Schwarz magic ceilings (T4a-T4d); and (V) ring-free Z_9 divided-power char-3 Alltop MUBs for W(3)^tensor-{1,2,3,4}, Z[zeta_5] certificates for W(5)^tensor-{1,2}, and exact Fubini-Study QGT metric g_{theta,theta} (T5a-T5d).
